name.value: Tata AIA Life Insurance Linked Comprehensive Health Rider
name.quote: Tata AIA Life Insurance Linked Comprehensive Health Rider

uin.note: Brochure supplied by the user. The site page for this rider was not found; ULIP product pages name V02 and V03. No policy document yet.

linked_or_non_linked.value: non-linked, non-participating individual health rider; separate premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: A Non-Linked, Non- Participating Individual Health rider
linked_or_non_linked.note: Named "Linked" because it attaches to linked ULIPs; the brochure calls it non-linked.

waiver_of_premium.quote: choose multiple risk covers from a list of 5 which include disability
waiver_of_premium.note: Five options: accidental disability, multistage critical illness, cancer, cardiac and hospital cover. No premium waiver option found in the brochure.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.quote: choose multiple risk covers from a list of 5 which include disability

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: choose multiple risk covers from a list of 5 which include disability

critical_illness.value: Multistage CritiCare: 39 critical illnesses with minor stage claims at 25% and major at 100% of the insured amount, multiple claims. Cancer Care: early and late stage cancers. Cardiac Care: 14 minor and 8 major cardiac ailments. Lump sum, income up to 10 years, or both.

accidental_death.quote: choose multiple risk covers from a list of 5 which include disability

accidental_disability.value: Accidental Disability Care: total and permanent disability 100%, partial permanent disability by schedule (arm 50 to 60%, leg 40 to 60%, each eye 50%, each ear 30%), multiple claims, double benefit in listed public accidents.

term_cover.quote: choose multiple risk covers from a list of 5 which include disability

hospital_cash.value: HospiCare: fixed amount on hospitalisation, ICU benefit and a recuperation benefit for stays of 7 days or more.

other.value: Return of balance premium option; benefits as lump sum, income up to 10 years or both; cover can be extended to loved ones.
other.quote: Option to receive return of balance premiums on maturity

rider_term.value: Without return of balance premium: 5 to 57 years (cancer care to 70). With return of balance premium: 10 to 57 years (cancer care to 70). Not beyond the base plan term.
rider_term.quote: Benefit Option Terms and Premium Payment Options

premium_paying_rules.value: Single, limited or regular pay (see the brochure term table). Options can be added at inception or at a policy anniversary.
premium_paying_rules.quote: Benefit Option Terms and Premium Payment Options

entry_age.value: 18 to 65 years (Multistage Cancer Care from age 5); maturity age 75

sum_assured_limits.value: Rider sum assured is the maximum of the sum assured chosen under each benefit option; see the brochure for the formula (11 times annualised premium for limited and regular pay, 105% of premiums paid).

premium_deduction.note: The text read does not say whether the premium is separate or taken from units. Non-linked rider; assumed separate. Needs a second read.
